description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget for a Tic Tac Toe game board, including visual styling, interaction handling, and internal state for individual tiles.

classes.name: TicTacToeBoard
classes.description: A stateless widget representing the Tic Tac Toe game board with customizable tiles, highlights for winning lines, and tap interaction.

classes.name: _BoardTile
classes.description: A private widget for individual tiles on the game board, managing animations and display of player marks (X or O).

methods.name: build (TicTacToeBoard)
methods.description: Builds the entire game board UI with styling, grid layout, and interaction handling.

methods.description: Builds each individual tile, including tap handling and animations for mark display.

methods.name: _buildMark
methods.description: Returns the widget representing X or O mark based on the tile's state.
